# CenterMint

> CenterMint is a free iOS app (iOS 17+) that measures trading-card centering: the left/right and top/bottom border ratios of Pokémon, One Piece, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic, sports and other cards. It compares the measured ratio with the published front-side centering standards of PSA, BGS and CGC so collectors can check a card before paying for grading. Analysis runs on the device; no account; photos are not uploaded automatically. It is independent and not affiliated with Pokémon, PSA, Beckett or CGC.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760965068 (App ID 6760965068, bundle com.centermint.app)

## Key facts
- Centering ratio: 50/50 is perfect; 55/45 means the image sits 5% off center on that axis.
- PSA front-side limits: Gem Mint 10 = 55/45, Mint 9 = 60/40, NM-MT 8 = 65/35, NM 7 = 70/30.
- BGS front-side limits: Pristine 10 = 50/50, 9 = 55/45 to 60/40, 8 = 65/35.
- CGC front-side limits: Gem Mint 10 = 55/45, 9 = 60/40, 8 = 65/35.
- Workflow: photo or scan → automatic outer edge + inner printed border proposal → magnifier check and per-edge adjustment → ratios → compare with grader thresholds → keep front and back together.
- Languages in app: English, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- Optional Pro purchase: detailed reports, batch image and CSV export, saved presets, no ads.
